title: Successful Password Reset Request
preconditions: The customer must be a registered user with an email address linked to their account.
The customer must have access to the email account linked to their OrangeHRM account.

testSteps.action: Customer navigates to the login page and selects 'Forgot password'
testSteps.expectedResult: The system displays a prompt to enter the registered email address.

testSteps.action: Customer enters their email address and submits the request
testSteps.expectedResult: The system sends a one-time password-reset link to the provided email address.

expectedResults: The system displays a prompt to enter the registered email address.
The system sends a one-time password-reset link to the provided email address.

title: Successful Password Reset with Valid Link
preconditions: The customer must be a registered user with an email address linked to their account.
The customer must have access to the email account linked to their OrangeHRM account.

testSteps.action: Customer opens the email and clicks on the password-reset link
testSteps.expectedResult: The system verifies the link is valid and unexpired.

testSteps.action: Customer enters a new password and confirms it
testSteps.expectedResult: The system validates the new password against the password policy.
The system updates the password, signs out all active sessions, and displays a success confirmation message.

expectedResults: The system verifies the link is valid and unexpired.
The system validates the new password against the password policy.
The system updates the password, signs out all active sessions, and displays a success confirmation message.

title: Expired Password Reset Link
preconditions: The customer must be a registered user with an email address linked to their account.
The customer must have access to the email account linked to their OrangeHRM account.

testSteps.action: Customer receives the password-reset link but does not click it within the valid time frame.
testSteps.expectedResult: The system displays an error message indicating the link has expired and provides an option to request a new reset link.

expectedResults: The system displays an error message indicating the link has expired and provides an option to request a new reset link.

title: Invalid Email Address for Password Reset
preconditions: The customer must be a registered user with an email address linked to their account.

testSteps.action: Customer enters an email address that is not linked to any account.
testSteps.expectedResult: The system displays an error message indicating that the email address is not recognized and suggests checking the input or registering.

expectedResults: The system displays an error message indicating that the email address is not recognized and suggests checking the input or registering.

title: Invalid Reset Link Usage
preconditions: The customer must be a registered user with an email address linked to their account.

testSteps.action: Customer attempts to use an already-used reset link.
testSteps.expectedResult: The system displays an error message indicating the link is invalid and provides an option to request a new reset link.

expectedResults: The system displays an error message indicating the link is invalid and provides an option to request a new reset link.

title: Valid Email Format Check

testSteps.action: Customer enters an email address that is not in a valid format.
testSteps.expectedResult: The system displays an error message indicating the email format is invalid.

expectedResults: The system displays an error message indicating the email format is invalid.

title: New Password Policy Validation

testSteps.action: Customer enters a new password that does not meet the password policy.
testSteps.expectedResult: The system displays an error message indicating the new password does not meet the policy requirements.

expectedResults: The system displays an error message indicating the new password does not meet the policy requirements.
